theater: 滇池東岸昆州及西洱河道

battle.name: 隋平定爨翫昆州之戰
battle.theater: 滇池東岸昆州及西洱河道
battle.brief: 開皇十七年（597），隋文帝以益州總管韋世康為行軍總管，率軍自成都南下，渡西洱河，進逼滇池昆明，爨翫遣使乞降，昆州遂平，隋於其地置州立縣。卡面的埃及月牙劍屬青銅時代的外彎單刃劍，與本役相隔近三千年，並不在滇池現場；隋軍近身用環首直刃刀，西爨部眾則持柳葉直刀與竹盾。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 這場戰爭是隋朝開皇十七年（597）出兵西南、討平西爨首領爨翫的一次邊疆戰役，交戰雙方分別是以益州總管韋世康為行軍總管的隋軍，和以滇池昆明為都、據西南數千里山川的西爨爨氏政權。隋軍並非京師禁軍主力，而是以益州為基地徵發的州府兵與募兵，糧秣由岷江、褒水一線的水陸轉運供應，另配益州、梁州一帶熟悉山地的鄉導；行軍總管之下設行軍司馬與各部將校，由隋廷派出的行臺、錄事參預軍政，軍隊以步兵為主，兼有騎兵、弩手與長槊手，糧車、蒙牛與驢隊隨軍轉運。西爨一方則是部落聯盟式的政權：爨翫以昆明為據，節制滇池、寧州、越州、姚州一帶的爨氏部眾與城邑，兵員多為村社武裝，器械以刀、矛、弓箭為主，並有依滇池水勢行動的舟船與漁獵兵。戰役期間西邊的吐谷渾與党項仍牽制隋廷的西北兵力和糧道，南方的蒙舍詔勢力則在旁觀望，兩個方向都沒有介入這場仗；因此這是一場由中央單方面推動、以中原王朝對西南土著政權第一次制度性接管為特徵的戰役。
countriesEn: This war was a frontier campaign launched by the Sui court in the seventeenth year of the Kaihuang era (597) to put down Cuan Xuan, the ruler of the western Cuan. The two sides were the Sui army under Wei Shikang, Inspector General of Yizhou and appointed expeditionary commander (hangjun zongguan) for the operation, and the Xicuan Cuan polity, which held Kunming on Lake Dian and controlled thousands of li of mountains and rivers in the southwest. The Sui force was not drawn from the capital garrison. It consisted of prefectural and recruited troops mustered at Yizhou, with grain and supplies moved by water and land along the Min River and the Bao River, together with local guides from the Yizhou and Liangzhou areas who knew the mountain roads. Beneath the expeditionary commander served a deputy (hangjun sima) and the commanders of the several columns, while appointees of the travelling headquarters and the record-keepers took part in military administration. The host was mainly infantry, with cavalry, crossbowmen and long-spearmen added, and grain carts, pack oxen and donkey teams moved with the column. The Xicuan side was a league of tribes rather than a standing army: Cuan Xuan sat at Kunming and held the Cuan settlements and towns around Lake Dian, Ningzhou, Yuezhou and Yaozhou, his soldiers mostly village militia armed with knives, spears and bows, together with boatmen and fisher-fighters who moved on the lake. Throughout the campaign the Tuyuhun in the west and the Dangxiang still tied down the Sui court's troops and transport on the northwestern frontier, while the Mengshe power in the south merely watched; neither direction entered this war. It was therefore a campaign driven entirely from the centre, and marked by the first institutional takeover of a southwestern indigenous polity by a Chinese imperial court.
people: 隋文帝楊堅是這場戰役的最高決策者。開皇十七年，他詔以益州總管韋世康為行軍總管，率軍討爨翫，並在蜀地籌措軍糧、鹽貨與轉運人力，讓西南用兵不至於動搖京師。韋世康是此役的主帥，出身京兆杜陵，與隋室有姻親之誼，早年事北周，隨周武帝平齊、伐突厥，開皇初年歷任各州總管；開皇七年（587）他以行軍總管身份北擊吐谷渾，在鄯州一線失利而退，事後被免官、尋復起用，開皇十年（590）任益州總管，至開皇十七年再度以行軍總管出師，同年平定西爨，還朝後除襄州總管，開皇二十年（600）卒於任上。這次西南用兵是他前半生軍事履歷中少數真正取勝的一役。爨翫是西爨政權的首領，面對隋軍壓境，他選擇了遣使乞降而不是死守，這個決定直接決定了此役以政治收束而不是攻城屠殺收場。爨氏各部首領與村社首戶在西洱河至滇池一線各自把守村寨，成為隋軍推進的實際障礙。隋軍內部還有大批無名的鄉導、斥候、輜重兵與隨軍文吏，那是這場山地遠征真正走完的部分。
peopleEn: Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, was the highest decision-maker in this campaign. In the seventeenth year of Kaihuang he issued the edict appointing Wei Shikang, Inspector General of Yizhou, as expeditionary commander to take the field against Cuan Xuan, and he saw to grain, salt and transport labour in the Shu region so that a war in the far southwest would not shake the capital. Wei Shikang was the commander of the operation. A native of Duling in the Jingzhao region, he was bound to the Sui house by marriage, served Northern Zhou in his youth and followed Emperor Wu of Zhou in the campaigns against Qi and the Turks, and held the post of Inspector General of several prefectures in the early Kaihuang years. In the seventh year of Kaihuang (587) he went north as expeditionary commander against the Tuyuhun and was defeated in the Shanzhou area; he was removed from office, then restored to it, and in the tenth year of Kaihuang (590) was made Inspector General of Yizhou. In the seventeenth year he again took command as expeditionary commander, settled the Xicuan in that same year, returned to court and was appointed Inspector General of Xiangzhou, dying in office in the twentieth year of Kaihuang (600). This southwestern campaign was one of the few outright victories of his earlier military career. Cuan Xuan headed the Xicuan polity; pressed by the Sui army he chose to send envoys and ask for submission rather than hold out to the death, and that decision determined that the war ended in a political settlement rather than in storming and massacre. The Cuan clan heads and village elders along the stretch from Xier Lake to Lake Dian each guarded their own stockades, and these were the real obstacles the Sui advance had to pass. Inside the Sui force there were also large numbers of unnamed guides, scouts, baggage men and travelling clerks, and it was they who actually carried the mountain march through.
kits: 卡面上的埃及月牙劍是此役的標誌器物，但它並不在滇池的戰場上。月牙劍是古埃及中王國時期的外彎單刃短劍，銅質或青銅質，身形窄、刃向外彎弧、護手寬大，砍入之後不必把刃拔出，屬於早期單刃彎刀的源頭形制，比本役早了約兩千九百年。隋軍真正裝備的近身兵器是環首刀一類的直刃鐵刀，佩在腰間，單手揮砍，與北方騎兵和南方步卒的格鬥方式相配合；長兵器是白桿矛與長槊，配皮盾、札甲與鎧裙，射手用弓與弩，軍備中另有防矢的橹一類器具。西爨方面的器械更接近西南山地的實用傳統：柳葉形的直刃刀、柄上帶鉤的長刀、削尖的竹矛與骨鏃、石鏃箭，配皮甲與竹盾，並利用滇池的舟船作快速運輸。攻城器具方面，隋軍照例攜帶巢車、雲梯與擲石用的攻城砲，但因爨翫在兵臨城下時即遣使請降，此役並無實際攻城的紀錄，這些器械只是隨軍待命。軍需方面，益州是此役的後勤基地，鹽井、稻米、麥粟與牛馬驢隊構成補給線的實體，軍糧大半由岷江與褒水的水陸轉運。
kitsEn: The Egyptian khopesh shown on the card face is the emblematic piece of equipment for this war, but it was not on the battlefield by Lake Dian. The khopesh is a curved single-edged short sword of the Middle Kingdom period in Egypt, of copper or bronze, with a narrow body, an outward-curving blade and a broad hand guard, designed so that once the edge had entered the target it did not need to be pulled back out; it is the ancestor form of the early single-edged curved sword, and it predates this campaign by roughly two thousand nine hundred years. The Sui army's real close-combat weapon was the straight-edged iron knife of the ring-pommel type, worn at the waist and swung one-handed, matching the way northern cavalry and southern infantry fought; the long weapons were the white-shafted spear and the long sao, carried with hide shields, lamellar armour and armour skirts, while archers and crossbowmen provided the shooting arm, and the equipment train included mantlets and similar protection against arrows. The Xicuan arms were closer to the practical tradition of the southwestern mountains: willow-leaf shaped straight knives, long knives with hooked tangs, sharpened bamboo lances and bone or stone arrowheads, with hide armour and bamboo shields, and they used boats on Lake Dian for rapid movement. As for siege equipment, the Sui army carried as a matter of course siege towers, scaling ladders and stone-throwing engines, but because Cuan Xuan sent envoys to surrender as soon as the army reached the walls, there is no record of any actual assault in this war and these engines simply stood ready with the column. On the logistics side, Yizhou was the supply base of the operation: the salt wells, rice, wheat and millet, and the oxen, horses and donkeys formed the substance of the line of supply, with most of the grain moved by water and land along the Min and Bao rivers.
tactics: 隋軍的作戰方式並非強攻一面，而是行軍、壓迫與政治收束三段合一。開皇十七年，軍隊自成都出發，沿岷江支流谷道南下，經利州、寧州地界，取道姚州、越州方向，糧隊與斥候先行，重要渡口與山口逐段設營，保障後方糧道不被切斷。推進至西洱河一線時，隋軍先以弓弩與長矛列陣前出，迫使西爨部眾離開村寨集中結營，再由行軍總管遣使宣諭，說明朝廷既往不追舊怨、只求歸順。據《隋書》所記，爨翫的請降使者是在軍隊壓境的情況下抵達，隋軍隨即分兵佔領昆明與滇池周邊的城邑渡口，控制鹽井與交通節點，並未對滇池城邑實施強攻。防守方的部署以村寨為單位，西爨諸部各自結寨、依山阻水，兵力分散在滇池東岸與東南的谷地，靠使者往來拖延談判。西爨的失敗並非戰場上的崩潰，而是在失去統一指揮與外援之後，被迫在聯盟瓦解與城邑孤立之間作出選擇。整場戰役的勝負手在行軍速度、糧道安全與政治目標的清晰，而不在攻城技術。
tacticsEn: The Sui way of fighting was not a frontal assault but a combination of three things: the march, the pressure, and a political close. In the seventeenth year of Kaihuang the column left Chengdu and moved south along the valleys of the tributaries of the Min River, passing the territories of Lizhou and Ningzhou and taking the direction of Yaozhou and Yuezhou, with the baggage train and the scouts moving ahead and camps established stage by stage at the important crossings and passes so that the rearward line of supply could not be cut. On reaching the line of Xier Lake the Sui army first pushed forward in line with crossbows and long spears, forcing the Xicuan fighting men to leave their villages and concentrate in camped positions, and then the expeditionary commander sent envoys to proclaim that the court would not pursue old grievances and asked only for submission. As the Sui histories record it, the emissary carrying Cuan Xuan's request for surrender arrived while the army was already pressing in; the Sui troops then split to seize Kunming and the towns and crossings around Lake Dian, taking control of the salt wells and the traffic nodes, and no assault was made on the Dian settlements. On the defensive side the deployment was by village: each Cuan branch raised its own stockade and held the ground between mountain and water, the strength was scattered over the eastern and southeastern valleys of the lake, and time was bought by the shuttling of envoys and the dragging out of negotiations. The defeat of the Xicuan was not a collapse on the field of battle; having lost a unified command and any outside support, they were forced to choose between the breaking up of their league and the isolation of their towns. The decisive factors in the campaign were the speed of the march, the security of the supply line and the clarity of the political aim, not any technique of storming walls.
data: 可確定的數字有限，但仍有幾個座標可用。此役繫於隋文帝開皇十七年，即西元597年，從下詔出兵到昆州平定在同一年的上半年至年內完成，具體出兵的月份各書記載略有出入，通行的說法是二月奉詔。全軍的總兵力、戰損與俘獲數，《隋書》與《資治通鑑》都沒有留下確數，所以此處不列任何具體人數，只記錄可以核對的部分。地理上的數字較為明確：自益州成都到滇池昆明，山路行程約一千五百至二千里，中間要翻越劍閣一線的山嶺；滇池水面海拔約一千八百八十六公尺，鄰近的西洱海水位略高，約一千九百多公尺，兩處都是典型的雲南高原盆地，秋冬多霧、夏季多雨，行軍須依季候安排。制度上，隋朝此役之後在昆明置昆州，領昆澤等縣，把自西漢益州郡、西晉寧州之後中斷的郡縣建置重新接上，大業年間一度改置昆明郡。人口方面，史籍只說爨氏降眾有部分被移置蜀中與關內安置，數目不可考。以西晉末年爨氏入主益州算起，西爨統治滇池流域約二百五十年，597年是這個政權的終點。此外，韋世康在開皇七年討吐谷渾的失利，說明此役的指揮官是把西北邊事的教訓帶著走的。
dataEn: The numbers that can be fixed are few, but a few coordinates remain usable. The campaign is dated to the seventeenth year of Kaihuang under Emperor Wen of Sui, that is the year 597; the march was ordered and the pacification of Kunzhou both fell within the same year, from the first half of the year to its close, and the books differ slightly on the month in which the expedition was ordered, the usual account being that the edict came in the second month. Neither the Sui Shu nor the Zizhi Tongjian gives a firm figure for the total strength of the army, for losses, or for prisoners, so no specific headcounts are given here and only what can be checked is recorded. The geographical figures are clearer: from Chengdu in Yizhou to Kunming on Lake Dian the mountain road runs roughly fifteen hundred to two thousand li, with the ridge line around Jiange to be crossed; the surface of Lake Dian lies at about 1,886 metres above sea level, and nearby Xier Lake stands a little higher, near 1,900 metres, both being typical basins of the Yunnan plateau where fog is common in autumn and winter and rain frequent in summer, so the march had to be timed to the season. Institutionally, after this campaign the Sui set up Kunzhou at Kunming, with Kunze and other counties under it, joining up again the line of commandery-and-county government that had been interrupted since the Yizhou commandery of the Western Han and the Ningzhou of Western Jin; in the Daye years the seat was briefly reorganised as Kunming commandery. On population, the histories say only that part of the surrendered Cuan people were moved to Shu and to the capital region, and the numbers cannot be checked. Counting from the Cuan entry into Yizhou in the late Western Jin, the Xicuan had ruled the Lake Dian basin for about two hundred and fifty years, and 597 was the end of that polity. One further point: Wei Shikang's defeat against the Tuyuhun in the seventh year of Kaihuang shows that the commander of this campaign brought the lessons of the northwestern frontier with him.
cause: 打這場仗有四層原因疊在一起。第一層是隋朝自身的邊疆整合：開皇七年之後，隋先後平吐谷渾、平陳，疆域北抵陰山、東到海岸，唯獨西南的益州、寧州一帶名義上屬於隋朝，實際由爨氏控制了數百年，朝廷不能容忍一個不受羈縻的政權擋在通往西南與中南半島的路口。第二層是資源：滇池一帶的鹽井是蜀中最上等的財貨，爨氏據此設官收稅，隋朝要接管益州，就必須先切斷這條私鹽與私兵的通路。第三層是西北的邊患：吐谷渾與党項在隴右、河西牽制了隋朝的兵力和運力，益州總管府必須在後方維持一支能打的常備軍，爨翫的抗拒正好給了朝廷調動這支部隊的理由。第四層是政治效應：隋文帝平陳之後需要一場對外勝利來鞏固新朝威望，雲南之役可以由南向北傳遞朝廷對邊地有令必行的訊號。就爨翫一方而言，拒不接受詔使、繼續以部落聯盟的方式控制城邑與鹽井，本身就是與隋朝體制無法並存的選擇。
causeEn: Four causes lie one upon another behind this war. The first is the Sui court's own consolidation of the frontier: after 587 the Sui had subdued the Tuyuhun and then the Chen, and the realm reached from the Yinshan in the north to the sea in the east, while in the southwest the districts of Yizhou and Ningzhou belonged to the Sui in name only and had in fact been held for several hundred years by the Cuan; the court could not tolerate an unassimilated polity blocking the road to the southwest and to the Indochinese peninsula. The second is resources: the salt wells around Lake Dian were the finest source of wealth in Shu, and the Cuan had officials there to collect the tax, so before the Sui could take over Yizhou it had to cut the private salt and private military channels. The third is the trouble in the northwest: the Tuyuhun and the Dangxiang tied down the Sui's troops and transport in Longyou and Hexi, and the office of the Inspector General of Yizhou had to keep a standing force fit for service in the rear, and Cuan Xuan's resistance gave the court the reason to move that force. The fourth is political effect: after the fall of Chen, Emperor Wen of Sui needed an external victory to give the new dynasty prestige, and a war in Yunnan could carry the message, from the south northward, that the court was obeyed in the borderlands. For Cuan Xuan's side, refusing the imperial envoys and continuing to hold the towns and the salt wells through a tribal league was itself a choice incompatible with the Sui order.
impact: 昆州平定是雲南政治史上一次制度性的轉折。此後滇池地區第一次被真正納入中原王朝的州縣體系：隋朝設昆州、領諸縣、派官置吏，把西晉以來名義上的寧州改造成有實際駐軍與戶籍的邊州。爨氏的宗族與部眾被拆散，一部分隨軍北遷安置於蜀郡與關內，一部分留在原地編入州縣的屬戶，西爨作為獨立的西南政權就此結束。對隋朝而言，這條通道的打開意味著從成都通往南詔與中南半島的商路、鹽路與軍事通道從此有了可以反覆使用的官方節點；後來唐初在雲南設置安寧都護府與都督府，終於把安寧、昆澤一帶納入正式建置，方向正是從此役定下的。對西南本地勢力而言，爨氏的突然退場留下了權力真空：殘餘的西爨勢力退往滇西與滇南，彼此爭鬥，直到八世紀中葉被南詔蒙舍詔兼併，南詔由此得到滇池流域的腹地，才有條件在洱海地區建立自己的王權。這條連續的因果鏈從597年算起，跨越了一百五十餘年。
impactEn: The pacification of Kunzhou was an institutional turning point in the political history of Yunnan. For the first time the Lake Dian region was genuinely drawn into the commandery-and-county system of a Chinese court: the Sui established Kunzhou with several counties, appointed officials and set up clerks, turning the Ningzhou that had existed in name since Western Jin into a real border prefecture with a garrison and a registered population. The Cuan clan and its followers were broken up, some being taken north with the army and settled in Shu and in the capital region, others remaining on the spot and enrolled as dependent households of the new prefectures, and the Xicuan as an independent southwestern polity came to an end. For the Sui, opening this corridor meant that the trade route, the salt route and the military road running from Chengdu to Nanzhao and to the Indochinese peninsula now possessed official staging points that could be used again and again; later, at the beginning of the Tang, when the Protectorate and Commandery of Anning were set up in Yunnan and Anning and Kunze were finally brought into formal administration, the direction had been fixed by this campaign. For the local powers of the southwest, the sudden exit of the Cuan left a vacuum of power: the surviving Xicuan groups withdrew to western and southern Yunnan and fought among themselves until they were absorbed in the middle of the eighth century by the Mengshe ruler of Nanzhao, which gained the hinterland of the Lake Dian basin and only then had the conditions to establish a royal authority around Erhai. That continuous chain of causes, reckoned from 597, runs for more than a hundred and fifty years.
result: 結果是西爨的抵抗以政治投降收場。爨翫在隋軍進抵昆明、逼近滇池的情況下遣使請降，隋軍未對昆明城邑發動強攻，戰役以昆州平定告終。隋文帝在雲南置昆州、領諸縣，遣官鎮守，把爨氏原有的統治機構改為州縣建置；行軍總管韋世康引軍還朝，因平定西南之功除襄州總管，開皇二十年（600）病卒。從軍事角度說，此役以極小的接觸換取了完整的政治效果：以封閉的滇池盆地為舞台，隋軍用行軍與外交各走一步，讓一個延續約二百五十年的土著政權在沒有大規模戰鬥的情況下解體。但成果並不穩固。隋朝在雲南的實際控制依賴益州方向的駐軍與糧道，隋末天下大亂，昆州很快落入地方勢力與西爨殘部手中，州縣建置名存實亡，雲南重新回到本地勢力主導的狀態，直到唐代重新設治、南詔崛起，這段真空才真正被填上。
resultEn: In the end the resistance of the Xicuan was closed by political submission. Cuan Xuan sent envoys to ask for surrender when the Sui army had reached Kunming and was pressing on Lake Dian; the Sui made no assault on the town, and the campaign ended with the pacification of Kunzhou. The Sui court set up Kunzhou with its counties in Yunnan, posted officials to hold it, and turned the Cuan administrative structure into a commandery-and-county administration. The expeditionary commander Wei Shikang led his troops home and was appointed Inspector General of Xiangzhou for the achievement of settling the southwest, dying of illness in the twentieth year of Kaihuang (600). Viewed militarily, the campaign bought a complete political result with the smallest possible contact: on the stage of the closed Lake Dian basin the Sui army advanced the march and the diplomacy each by one step, and an indigenous polity that had lasted about two hundred and fifty years dissolved without large-scale fighting. The results, however, were not secure. The Sui grip on Yunnan rested on the garrison and the supply line pointing back toward Yizhou, and when the empire broke up at the end of the Sui, Kunzhou quickly fell into the hands of local powers and the surviving Xicuan groups, the commandery-and-county structure survived in name only, and Yunnan returned to a state dominated by local forces, until the Tang re-established its administration and Nanzhao rose, and the vacuum was at last filled.
